stage: Before any N1 target fit. Full source study complete/audited. Existing H1 and X target outcomes already examined; exploratory method study.
question: Does norm/basis-constrained source transfer and source-preserving adaptation improve on generic controls and strong causal history readouts, across calibration budgets?
split: Original L7 author-loader eligible rows; first k whole support trials, common later query after 5 whole trials. Per-fold normalization uses only fitting trials. No future label/activity in fitting, PCA or selection.

initializations.source: Real, synthetic, time_shift, 3 source-trained seeds each, selected solely on real source day3.
initializations.generic: V1, multiscale, random0/1/2, each projected to variant constraint; same architecture/head.
initializations.matched: For each real-source seed, time reversal and random lag direction with identical initial row Gram via Cholesky(GG.T) times a seeded 25x5 positive-diagonal QR basis. Controls retain source information for unit variant; orthogonal variant Gram is identity.
initializations.pca: One support-spike-only temporal PCA bank per target set/budget, projected to variant constraint. Never query spikes/labels.

adaptation.frozen: Checkpoint0 is mandatory, with same initial support-selected lambda as each adapted branch. Frozen comparisons reported for all budgets, never select mode by query.
adaptation.optimizer: 150 updates, LR0.001, clip1, checkpoints0/15/30/60/90/150. Unit rows: Adam then unit projection. Subspace: horizontal Grassmann global-clipped SGD then polar projection. No coordinatewise Adam for subspace.
adaptation.objective: Whole-support-trial LOO, heldout-trial SSE normalized by fitting-trial target variance, cycling holdout=t mod k; smoothness1e-4; free beta0 or anchor beta1.
adaptation.anchor: Unit variant ||G-G0||_F^2/(2*5). Subspace 1-||Q Q0.T||_F^2/5, normalized projector distance (basis invariant). Weight1 fixed, not tuned on target queries; L2-SP is established prior art.
adaptation.ridge_selection: Minimum mean whole-trial LOO at checkpoint0; smallest-lambda ties. Fixed over all target updates, shared frozen/free/anchor.
adaptation.checkpoint_selection: Minimum mean pure support LOO among all six checkpoints, earliest ties. Support LOO repeatedly optimized, not independent validation. Also report frozen and final150. Retain all raw checkpoint predictions.
adaptation.failure: Any nonfinite loss/gradient/update/score or missing checkpoint terminates explicitly; no implicit retry, silent fallback or outcome-dependent exclusion.

references: Raw/sqrt full25lag history, fixed lambda1/10 plus support-only selected lambda. Run once per target file/budget, shared by source/variant. All6 retained.
execution: Source-only small-step complete pipeline and independent NumPy gradient/head/schedule/selection audit first. X complete phase then its audit, H1 complete phase then its audit. No favorable outcome gate. Both sources/variants/all arms retained.
analysis: Paired per-file variance-weighted R2, average 3 seeds within arm. 10000 date-cluster bootstrap draws seed20261011, unadjusted/descriptive. All real-minus-every comparator, real anchor-minus-free and adapted-minus-frozen; all2/3/5 budgets, each source/variant separately. SourceX-to-X is within-animal cross-day, sourceL-to-X is cross-animal, macaque-to-H1 cross-species. No animal/participant population inference. Retain every lower-budget real2vscontrols3/5 and real3vscontrols5, each adaptation mode; no same-budget gain labeled as label savings.
claim_limits: No untouched target cohort; no official FALCON challenge score, fresh-human replication, biological-plausibility claim for global backprop, universal transfer claim, test-time unlabeled adaptation, clinical readiness or state-of-the-art until proper external baseline executed.

prior_sources.overlap: Source-preserving L2-SP regularization is not novel.
POSSM already shows fast causal monkey-to-human transfer and compares learning efficiency.

pre_fit_amendments.reason: Add implementation/dependency bindings, explicit cross-budget analysis and source-only dry access guard before any N1targetfit. Same scientific settings.
